meta.name: quantitative-analysis
meta.description: Answers a business question with data without fooling yourself — framing the question so an answer would change something, choosing the right comparison, checking the data before trusting it, recognizing the traps that produce confident wrong answers (aggregation reversals, survivorship, regression to the mean, multiple comparisons), and reporting uncertainty honestly. Use this to run an analysis, review one before acting on it, or work out why two people looking at the same data reached opposite conclusions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规避统计陷阱,用数据得出可信结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需用数据支撑决策，又担心结论被偏差误导
copy.tagline_en: Avoid statistical traps and reach trustworthy conclusions from data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often use data to support decisions but worry about flawed conclusions

howto.what: 我会先帮你把商业问题改成“答案能改变决策”的对比问题,检查数据来源、空值、重复和口径变化,提防聚合反转、幸存者偏差、均值回归等陷阱,最后给出带区间和局限的结论。
howto.when: 当你要求做数据分析、审阅现成分析,或解释两人看同一数据得出相反结论时触发。

say.text: 这次改版后新用户留存真的比上一批高吗?帮我设计对比
say.note: 会先明确比较基准再分析

say.text: 审一下这份转化率报告,有没有幸存者偏差或聚合陷阱?
say.note: 会检查数据质量和常见错误

say.text: 我和同事看同一份数据结论相反,帮我仲裁谁更对
say.note: 会指出双方论据与局限

howto.what_en: I will help you turn a business question into a comparison that can change a decision, check data provenance, nulls, duplicates and definition changes, watch for traps such as aggregation reversals, survivorship, regression to the mean, and report estimates with ranges and limitations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run an analysis, review an existing one, or explain why two people reached opposite conclusions from the same data.

say_en.text: Did retention really improve for the new cohort after this change? Help me design the comparison.
Review this conversion report for survivorship or aggregation traps.
say_en.note: Checks data quality and known pitfalls.

say_en.text: A colleague and I read the same data and disagree. Help settle which read is sound.
